svg.title: RC Parts Finder: P2P and B2C flows
svg.desc: Top lane, P2P (free). Two RC clubs in the same city, Club A (for example RC Club Cuenca) and Club B (for example Cuenca Touring), each with a WhatsApp group and members. Step 1: members post HAVE or NEED listings. Step 2: the bot matches them by part number or text, inside the same club (a member of Club B has a spur gear another Club B member needs) or across clubs in the same city (a Club A member has a shock a Club B member needs). Step 3: the bot DMs both members. Step 4: they meet and swap or sell in person. Step 5: a member tells the bot the item is sold; the listing closes and the other side is told. A Club A member needs a wheel no club has, so that need goes to the bottom lane. Bottom lane, B2C (paid import). Step 6: no match in any club. Step 7: the bot quotes an import, computed in code: store price $13.00, plus 0.25 lb at $7 per lb = $1.74, plus 12% for "we order it" = $1.56, total $16.30. Step 8: the member accepts with "sí". Step 9: the member sends the deposit receipt PDF by DM. Step 10: the bot forwards it to the maintainer, who checks the bank transfer by hand. Step 11: the maintainer replies "confirmar" and the quote is paid. Step 12: a cron job builds the order batch, hourly or daily. Step 13: the maintainer places one order per store. Step 14: parts ship to the US forwarding address. Step 15: they are imported. Step 16: they come back to the club. Self-order branch: after accepting, the member buys the part, ships it to the US forwarding address and pays us only the weight fee, $1.74; with the store price their total is $14.74), joining at step 14.
svg.text: How a part reaches a member
Free swaps inside and across clubs first; a paid import only when no club has the part.
